summary: VinFast Auto Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 30, 2026, announcing the completion of the transfer of its equity interest in VinFast Trading and Production JSC (VFTP) to a group of purchasers. The transaction followed the split of certain VFTP assets and operations into a newly formed entity. No financial terms, premium, or advisors were disclosed; the filing states only that required corporate, regulatory, and creditor approvals were obtained. VinFast retains no equity in VFTP. The divestiture is part of a strategic shift toward an asset-light model, focusing on R&D, technology, branding, and sales globally. Watch for further restructuring details or any subsequent asset-light transactions.
